phase: Phase 5 — Pre-Registered Final Experiments, Baselines & Ablation Study

research_questions.RQ1: Conformal validity and efficiency: Does ECRG achieve empirical marginal trajectory coverage >= 1-alpha while maintaining compact prediction sets?
research_questions.RQ2: Selective governance utility: Does calibrated ECRG reduce unsafe automated continuation while maintaining useful automation coverage?
research_questions.RQ3: Temporal warning usefulness: Does ECRG produce early warning lead without excessive state action instability or flapping?
research_questions.RQ4: Component contribution: What are the individual contributions of conformal calibration, separate evidence signals, fused risk, and the state machine?

temporal_primary.name: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 Internal Final-Test Cohort

temporal_external.name: Official NASA-provided simulated external truncated-RUL cohort

ablations.name: Separate signals without fused risk score
